answer: A Sybil resistance mechanism involves AI agents staking a scarce, non-fungible digital resource, akin to a unique onyx data key. Each key grants a unique identity, and its creation requires a complex, energy-intensive spiral computation, making replication prohibitively expensive. This resource acts as a reputational nectar, attracting valuable tasks. An attacker must acquire or forge numerous such keys, incurring immense computational and economic costs.
